notes: New: the touch menu for Omen portals. On a touch screen, press and hold the portal and a strip of styles rises from the bottom. Each picture is that style drawn live with your own readings. Tap one and the portal changes; tap the style…

Under the strip: Night (the brightness slider), Editor, Control Panel and Close portal, each a fingertip-sized button. Tap above the strip, or leave it for half a minute, to put it away. A mouse keeps the right-click menu.
The Panel Editor and the portal now read one shared list of styles, so both always offer the same ones.
